harbour-master.text: Docking clearance granted. Hold your approach vector and cut thrust at two hundred metres. Welcome to Meridian Port; the harbour master will be with you shortly.

siren-whisper.text: Well now. Look who finally came back to me. Kill the engines, captain, and stay a while. The stars can wait. I have been so very patient, and I do not intend to share you tonight.
